tables of Floci's docs at that tag (`registry/floci-ops-2.3.0.json`). The contract column is
the last run of the contract tests (`registry/contract-results.json`), recorded 2026-11-01 on `sha256:e0b292df4dc9…`.

Run `labctl coverage <lab>` for one lab's verdict and `labctl coverage --catalog <csv>` for the
public catalog.
